snippet.title: Stygian: Outer Gods | Content Update "Souls of the Silent Tide" Available Now!
snippet.description:
Stygian: Outer Gods in its Early Access on PC just received the first Content Update, dubbed the "Souls of the Silent Tide" update, introducing the otherworldly House of Mists with its surrounding Blood Forest area and a ghastly ritual site of the head witch Agatha, as well as a secret surprise for the most diligent and perseverant of explorers. These locales have been brought to life with new intriguing characters and deadly enemies, together with new challenging puzzles and quests. 

The game is now available in Early Access on PC, with the 1.0 launch planned for PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S at a later date. 

AVAILABLE NOW IN EARLY ACCESS: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2581410/Stygian_Outer_Gods/
https://www.gog.com/en/game/stygian_outer_gods
https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/stygian-outer-gods-e5f4c5

WISHLIST ON CONSOLES NOW:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10010486
https://www.xbox.com/games/store/stygian-outer-gods/9pgxchm1bcjz

Set in the universe of Stygian: Reign of the Old Ones, the game lets players witness and influence the events preceding the Black Day. Immerse yourself in a unique world full of dangers, unexplored dark corners, and looming evil beyond mortal comprehension.

Accompany an enigmatic occult researcher on a voyage to the foggy town of Kingsport to find your missing father and uncover dark secrets surrounding a coming catastrophe. You are shipwrecked and soon encounter the nightmares that have haunted this place for centuries. Will you be able to find your way out, keep your sanity, and prevent the coming of the ancient Outer Gods, or maybe being insane is the key to salvation?

Join the Stygian: Outer Gods Discord: https://discord.gg/AzSgYMkbfw

Follow Fulqrum Publishing on:
